summary: In the hall, Neo has been shot three times in the chest and falls onto the blue shag carpeting, his his blood streaking down the wallpaper. Agent Smith stands above him, weapon still trained his weapon and taking no chances, then orders someone off-screen to "Check him."

what_changes.after: shot three times in the chest and fallen to the floor
what_changes.evidence: Three holes in his chest, Neo falls
